data.summary: Wired emit_event into kickoff, branch, archive, and open_pr lifecycle scripts; added event log display to status.py; documented event schema, types, and design invariants in SKILL.md and implementation.md Rules 9-10
data.canon_entry: Cicadas now maintains an append-only events.jsonl per initiative recording lifecycle transitions (initiative.kicked_off, branch.created, worktree.created, specs.archived, pr.opened, pr.blocked) and agent-emitted events (task.complete, partition.complete). All reads go through get_events.py.
data.notes_for_evaluator: Verify events appear in status.py output; verify emit failure does not abort primary operation (check=False semantics); verify events.jsonl created in correct path via get_registry_root
